# Prompt suite for ingress_token_bench.py — repo-comprehension questions that
# normally make an agent explore the tree. Keep answers brief; do not edit code.
# One prompt per line; lines starting with # are ignored.
Which source file implements the Codex /v1/responses streaming handler, and what function name? Answer in one line.
Where is the kb's DB2 connection URL resolved at startup, and which env var overrides the config file? One short paragraph.
Name the function that builds the <aimee-context> pre-injection envelope and the file it lives in. One line.
How does the thin client decide between local-socket and remote-TCP transport? Summarize in two sentences.
Which config field gates context pre-injection for the model ingresses, and what is its default? One line.
What caps the TCP connect phase of the HTTP client, and why? Two sentences.
List the three services bundled in the aimee-kb plugin. One line.
Where are MCP tool definitions assembled for the tools/list response? Name the function. One line.
